classification.criterion: Read-only means the tool only reads TradingView state or data. It may transiently open a fixed panel/editor for observation and, for capture_screenshot, write a local PNG. Side-effecting means the tool changes chart, study, drawing, alert, watchlist, layout, tab, script, or replay state; injects free-form input, clicks, keys, or arbitrary JavaScript; or launches/updates the MCP server.

phase1_access.policy_reference: D-11: temporary tv-mcp-diagnostic agent with exactly three allowed tools

tools.name: tv_health_check
tools.description: Check CDP connection to TradingView and return current chart state
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.healthCheck(); reads CDP target and chart state. The optional update check is a read-only network request.

tools.name: tv_discover
tools.description: Report which known TradingView API paths are available and their methods
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.discover(); enumerates available TradingView API paths without changing them.

tools.name: tv_ui_state
tools.description: Get current UI state: which panels are open, what buttons are visible/enabled/disabled
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.uiState(); reads panel, button, chart, and replay state only.

tools.name: tv_launch
tools.description: Launch TradingView Desktop with Chrome DevTools Protocol (remote debugging) enabled. Auto-detects install location on Mac, Windows, and Linux, including Windows MSIX/Store installs. If a Store install blocks the debug port, automatically relaunches from a local package copy (result then includes msix_local_copy: true; the first fallback launch copies ~330MB one time, so it can take a minute).
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.launch(); launches or kills TradingView Desktop as a process-level side effect.

tools.name: tv_update
tools.description: Update this MCP server to the latest version: git fast-forward of origin/main + npm ci when dependencies changed. Safe by design ΓÇö refuses on non-git installs, dirty working trees, non-main branches, or diverged history. After a successful update the MCP server must be restarted to load the new code.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.update(); performs a git fast-forward and npm ci in the MCP clone.

tools.name: chart_get_state
tools.description: Get current chart state (symbol, timeframe, chart type, indicators)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getState(); reads symbol, timeframe, chart type, and studies only.

tools.name: chart_set_symbol
tools.description: Change the chart symbol
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setSymbol(); changes the chart symbol.

tools.name: chart_set_timeframe
tools.description: Change the chart timeframe/resolution
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setTimeframe(); changes the chart timeframe.

tools.name: chart_set_type
tools.description: Change chart type
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setType(); changes the chart type.

tools.name: chart_manage_indicator
tools.description: Add or remove an indicator/study on the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.manageIndicator(); adds or removes a study on the chart.

tools.name: chart_get_visible_range
tools.description: Get the visible date range (unix timestamps) and bars range on the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getVisibleRange(); reads the visible range only.

tools.name: chart_set_visible_range
tools.description: Zoom the chart to a specific date range (unix timestamps)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setVisibleRange(); changes the chart viewport.

tools.name: chart_scroll_to_date
tools.description: Jump the chart view to center on a specific date
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.scrollToDate(); moves the chart viewport.

tools.name: symbol_info
tools.description: Get detailed metadata about the current symbol (name, exchange, type, description)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.symbolInfo(); reads current-symbol metadata only.

tools.name: symbol_search
tools.description: Search for symbols by name or keyword
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.symbolSearch(); queries TradingView's symbol-search REST API without touching the chart.

tools.name: pine_get_source
tools.description: Get current Pine Script source code from the editor
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getSource(); reads the Pine editor source. It may open the Pine Editor if closed, but does not change script content or chart state.

tools.name: pine_set_source
tools.description: Set Pine Script source code in the editor
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setSource(); replaces the Pine Editor source.

tools.name: pine_compile
tools.description: Compile / add the current Pine Script to the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.compile(); compiles and adds the script to the chart.

tools.name: pine_get_errors
tools.description: Get Pine Script compilation errors from Monaco markers
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getErrors(); reads Monaco markers. It may open the Pine Editor if closed, but does not change content.

tools.name: pine_save
tools.description: Save the current Pine Script (Ctrl+S)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.save(); saves the current Pine script.

tools.name: pine_get_console
tools.description: Read Pine Script console/log output (compile messages, log.info(), errors)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getConsole(); reads Pine console output. It may open the Pine Editor if closed, but does not change content.

tools.name: pine_smart_compile
tools.description: Intelligent compile: detects button, compiles, checks errors, reports study changes
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.smartCompile(); compiles the script and may change studies on the chart.

tools.name: pine_new
tools.description: Create a new blank Pine Script
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.newScript(); creates a new Pine script.

tools.name: pine_open
tools.description: Open a saved Pine Script by name
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.openScript(); opens a saved Pine script.

tools.name: pine_list_scripts
tools.description: List saved Pine Scripts
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.listScripts(); reads the saved-script list through the pine-facade REST API.

tools.name: pine_analyze
tools.description: Run static analysis on Pine Script code WITHOUT compiling ΓÇö catches array out-of-bounds, unguarded array.first()/last(), bad loop bounds, and implicit bool casts. Works offline, no TradingView connection needed.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.analyze(); runs offline static analysis with no TradingView connection or mutation.

tools.name: pine_check
tools.description: Compile Pine Script via TradingView's server API without needing the chart open. Returns compilation errors/warnings. Useful for validating code before injecting into the chart.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.check(); validates source through TradingView's server-side compile API without changing the chart or editor.

tools.name: data_get_ohlcv
tools.description: Get OHLCV bar data from the chart. Use summary=true for compact stats instead of all bars (saves context).
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getOhlcv(); reads chart bars only.

tools.name: data_get_indicator
tools.description: Get indicator/study info and input values
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getIndicator(); reads study info and input values only.

tools.name: data_get_strategy_results
tools.description: Get strategy performance metrics from Strategy Tester. Auto-opens the panel and auto-unhides a hidden strategy (TradingView never computes reports for hidden strategies); result includes unhidden_strategies when that happened.
tools.risk_reason: Calls ensureStrategyTesterReady(); auto-opens the Strategy Tester and unhides strategies before reading results.

tools.name: data_get_trades
tools.description: Get trade list from Strategy Tester. Auto-opens the panel and auto-unhides a hidden strategy.
tools.risk_reason: Calls ensureStrategyTesterReady(); auto-opens the Strategy Tester and unhides strategies before reading trades.

tools.name: data_get_equity
tools.description: Get equity curve data from Strategy Tester
tools.risk_reason: Calls ensureStrategyTesterReady(); auto-opens the Strategy Tester and unhides strategies before reading equity.

tools.name: quote_get
tools.description: Get real-time quote data for a symbol (price, OHLC, volume). If symbol is provided and differs from the current chart, the chart is briefly switched to fetch the quote and then restored ΓÇö adds ~1-2s and serializes parallel calls.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getQuote(); a non-blank symbol can briefly switch and restore the chart symbol.

tools.name: depth_get
tools.description: Get order book / DOM (Depth of Market) data from the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getDepth(); reads DOM/order-book elements only.

tools.name: data_get_pine_lines
tools.description: Read horizontal price levels drawn by Pine Script indicators (line.new). Returns deduplicated price levels per study. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getPineLines(); reads Pine line drawings only.

tools.name: data_get_pine_labels
tools.description: Read text labels drawn by Pine Script indicators (label.new). Returns text and price pairs. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getPineLabels(); reads Pine labels only.

tools.name: data_get_pine_tables
tools.description: Read table data drawn by Pine Script indicators (table.new). Returns formatted text rows per table. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getPineTables(); reads Pine tables only.

tools.name: data_get_pine_boxes
tools.description: Read box/zone boundaries drawn by Pine Script indicators (box.new). Returns deduplicated {high, low} price zones. Use study_filter to target a specific indicator.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getPineBoxes(); reads Pine boxes only.

tools.name: data_get_study_values
tools.description: Get current indicator values from the data window for all visible studies (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMAs, custom indicators with plot()).
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getStudyValues(); reads data-window study values only.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the TradingView chart
tools.risk_reason: Captures pixels through CDP or TradingView's screenshot API and writes only a local PNG. It does not change chart configuration or data; the optional api method may trigger TradingView's own screenshot action.

tools.name: draw_shape
tools.description: Draw a shape/line on the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.drawShape(); creates a drawing on the chart.

tools.name: draw_list
tools.description: List all shapes/drawings on the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.listDrawings(); reads drawing IDs and names only.

tools.name: draw_clear
tools.description: Remove all drawings from the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.clearAll(); removes all drawings from the chart.

tools.name: draw_remove_one
tools.description: Remove a specific drawing by entity ID
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.removeOne(); removes a drawing from the chart.

tools.name: draw_get_properties
tools.description: Get properties and points of a specific drawing
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.getProperties(); reads drawing properties only.

tools.name: alert_create
tools.description: Create a price alert on the current chart symbol via TradingView's alert API
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.create(); creates a TradingView price alert.

tools.name: alert_list
tools.description: List active alerts
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.list(); reads active alerts through the pricealerts REST API.

tools.name: alert_delete
tools.description: Delete a specific alert by id, or all active alerts
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.deleteAlerts(); deletes one or all active alerts.

tools.name: batch_run
tools.description: Run an action across multiple symbols and/or timeframes
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.batchRun(); iterates chart symbols/timeframes and can run screenshots, OHLCV reads, or Strategy Tester actions.

tools.name: replay_start
tools.description: Start bar replay mode, optionally at a specific date
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.start(); starts bar replay mode.

tools.name: replay_step
tools.description: Advance one bar in replay mode
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.step(); advances one replay bar.

tools.name: replay_autoplay
tools.description: Toggle autoplay in replay mode, optionally set speed
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.autoplay(); toggles replay autoplay or changes its speed.

tools.name: replay_stop
tools.description: Stop replay and return to realtime
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.stop(); stops replay and returns to realtime.

tools.name: replay_trade
tools.description: Execute a trade action in replay mode (buy, sell, or close position)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.trade(); executes a buy, sell, or close action in replay.

tools.name: replay_status
tools.description: Get current replay mode status
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.status(); reads replay availability, mode, date, and autoplay state only.

tools.name: indicator_set_inputs
tools.description: Change indicator/study input values (e.g., length, source, period)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setInputs(); changes study input values.

tools.name: indicator_toggle_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide an indicator/study on the chart
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.toggleVisibility(); shows or hides a study.

tools.name: indicator_search
tools.description: Search TradingView's Indicators dialog for indicators, strategies, and community/public scripts by keyword. Returns matching titles grouped by section (Technicals, Community, My scripts, etc.).
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.searchStudies(); opens the Indicators dialog and types a free-form query into it. The dialog is closed after reading, but the tool injects UI input.

tools.name: indicator_add
tools.description: Search the Indicators dialog and add a result to the chart by name. Works for strategies and community scripts, not just built-ins. Returns the new study entity_id.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.addStudyFromSearch(); searches the Indicators dialog and adds a study to the chart.

tools.name: watchlist_get
tools.description: Get all symbols from the current TradingView watchlist with last price, change, and change%
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.get(); reads watchlist rows. It may open the watchlist panel if closed, but does not change watchlist contents.

tools.name: watchlist_add
tools.description: Add a symbol to the TradingView watchlist
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.add(); adds a symbol to the watchlist.

tools.name: watchlist_add_bulk
tools.description: Add multiple symbols to the TradingView watchlist
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.addBulk(); adds multiple symbols to the watchlist.

tools.name: watchlist_remove
tools.description: Remove one or more symbols from the active TradingView watchlist
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.remove(); removes symbols from the watchlist.

tools.name: ui_click
tools.description: Click a UI element by aria-label, data-name, text content, or class substring
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.click(); dispatches a UI click.

tools.name: ui_open_panel
tools.description: Open, close, or toggle TradingView panels (pine-editor, strategy-tester, watchlist, alerts, trading)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.openPanel(); opens, closes, or toggles a TradingView panel.

tools.name: ui_fullscreen
tools.description: Toggle TradingView fullscreen mode
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.fullscreen(); toggles fullscreen mode.

tools.name: layout_list
tools.description: List saved chart layouts
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.layoutList(); reads saved layouts only.

tools.name: layout_switch
tools.description: Switch to a saved chart layout by name or ID
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.layoutSwitch(); loads a saved chart layout.

tools.name: ui_keyboard
tools.description: Press keyboard keys or shortcuts (e.g., Enter, Escape, Alt+S, Ctrl+Z)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.keyboard(); dispatches keyboard input.

tools.name: ui_type_text
tools.description: Type text into the currently focused input/textarea element
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.typeText(); types text into the focused element.

tools.name: ui_hover
tools.description: Hover over a UI element by aria-label, data-name, or text content
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.hover(); dispatches pointer hover input.

tools.name: ui_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the chart or page up/down/left/right
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.scroll(); dispatches scroll input to the chart or page.

tools.name: ui_mouse_click
tools.description: Click at specific x,y coordinates on the TradingView window
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.mouseClick(); dispatches a mouse click at screen coordinates.

tools.name: ui_find_element
tools.description: Find UI elements by text, aria-label, or CSS selector and return their positions
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.findElement(); reads DOM element positions only.

tools.name: ui_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript code in the TradingView page context for advanced automation
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.uiEvaluate(); executes arbitrary JavaScript in the TradingView page.

tools.name: pane_list
tools.description: List all chart panes in the current layout with their symbols and active state
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.list(); reads pane symbols and layout metadata only.

tools.name: pane_set_layout
tools.description: Change the chart grid layout (e.g., single, 2x2, 2h, 3v)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setLayout(); changes the chart grid layout.

tools.name: pane_focus
tools.description: Focus a specific chart pane by index (0-based)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.focus(); changes the focused chart pane.

tools.name: pane_set_symbol
tools.description: Set the symbol on a specific pane by index
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.setSymbol(); changes the symbol on a chart pane.

tools.name: tab_list
tools.description: List all open TradingView chart tabs
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.list(); lists CDP chart tabs without changing them.

tools.name: tab_new
tools.description: Open a new chart tab. Optionally pick what to load in it: layout "new" creates a named blank layout, or pass a saved layout name to open it.
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.newTab(); opens a new chart tab.

tools.name: layout_new
tools.description: Create a new named blank chart layout (opens in a new tab)
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.newTab(); creates a new named layout in a new tab.

tools.name: tab_close
tools.description: Close the current chart tab
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.closeTab(); closes the current chart tab.

tools.name: tab_switch
tools.description: Switch to a chart tab by index
tools.risk_reason: Calls core.switchTab(); switches chart tabs.
